2608.30158.title: CPR for LLMs: Critical-Point Routing against Catastrophic Forgetting in Domain Adaptation
2608.30158.paper_summary: Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) is the de facto standard for adapting large language models (LLMs) to target domains, but it often degrades the model's general capabilities, a phenomenon known as catastrophic forgetting. Existing approaches typically modify the SFT loss to mitigate forgetting, but they inevitably operate along a domain-generality trade-off. In this work, we step outside this trade-off by decoupling the two capabilities at the model level: we keep the original base model for general capability, and selectively invoke the SFT expert only when domain-specific knowledge is required. Specifically, we propose CPR (Critical-Point Routing), a token-level routing framework between a base model and its expert derivative, based on critical tokens where the base model fails but the expert succeeds. We train a lightweight hierarchical router that estimates the expert-call probability per token, and pair it with a tailored inference procedure that combines momentum smoothing and threshold gating. Across diverse model-domain configurations, CPR achieves state-of-the-art across all settings, surpassing SFT expert by 1.4-5.5% in domain performance while recovering its general-capability drop from 3.4-14.5% to at most 0.5%, with minimal overhead from invoking the expert on only one-third of tokens.
2608.30158.paper_summary_zh: 監督微調（SFT）是將大型語言模型（LLMs）適應於目標領域的事實標準，但這通常會降低模型的一般能力，這一現象稱為災難性遺忘。現有的方法通常修改SFT損失以減輕遺忘，但它們不可避免地在領域通用性和專業性之間進行權衡。在本研究中，我們通過在模型層面解耦這兩種能力來超越這一權衡：我們保留原始基礎模型以保持一般能力，並在需要領域特定知識時選擇性地調用SFT專家。具體而言，我們提出了CPR（關鍵點路由），這是一個基於關鍵令牌的令牌級路由框架，連接基礎模型及其專家衍生模型，這些關鍵令牌是基礎模型失敗而專家成功的地方。我們訓練了一個輕量級的層次路由器，估計每個令牌的專家調用概率，並將其與一個量身定制的推理程序配對，該程序結合了動量平滑和閾值門控。在各種模型-領域配置中，CPR在所有設置中達到了最先進的水平，在領域性能上超過了SFT專家1.4-5.5%，同時將其一般能力的下降從3.4-14.5%恢復到最多0.5%，並且僅在三分之一的令牌上調用專家時帶來了最小的開銷。
